name: local-ai-model-matcher
title_zh: 报出显卡显存内存，它只推三款跑得动的本地大模型
tagline_zh: 怕装错模型白下 20GB？它先读你机器的显卡、显存、内存和系统，再按「最强能跑」「写代码最佳」「小而快」各推一款。
tagline_en: Tired of downloading 20GB models that won't run? It reads your GPU, VRAM, RAM, and OS, then suggests the most.
desc_en: Safely auto-detect the current machine's hardware (GPU, VRAM, system RAM, OS) with read-only commands, then recommend the top 3 local AI models to run — most powerful that fits, best for coding, and best small-and-fast — each with download links. Use when someone asks "what AI models can my computer run" or "what's the best local model for my rig".
why_zh: 只读命令探测硬件，不装驱动不改配置；按显存余量反推量化档位。
why_en: Read-only hardware probe, zero config changes. Suggests by VRAM headroom and quant level, not popularity — three picks that.
limit_zh: 只认本机硬件，不认云端 GPU；只推荐 llama.cpp 生态的 GGUF 模型，不覆盖 Ollama 专用格式。
limit_en: Local hardware only, no cloud GPUs. Recommends GGUF for llama.cpp, not Ollama formats. Windows VRAM detection may fail on some GPUs.
title_en: Reads your GPU/VRAM/RAM, then names 3 local models that fit
